request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Checkpoints from different training stages (Pretrained, Instruct, MPO, and full CascadeRL) are open-sourced with HF and ModelScope links. Conversion scripts (custom2hf, hf2custom) are provided. Code is on GitHub (OpenGVLab/InternVL). The card says all models and code are publicly released. The evaluation uses VLMEvalkit.
quotes: Here, we also open-source the model weights after different training stages for potential research usage.

> If you want to convert the checkpoint between these two formats, please refer to the scripts about [custom2hf](https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL/blob/main/internvl_chat/tools/internvl_custom2hf.py) and [hf2custom](https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL/blob/main/internvl_chat/tools/internvl_hf2custom.py).
All models and code are publicly released.
